name: CED - South Burlington
old_description: Our local strength scales to the national level – an account at CED Burlington plugs you into our network throughout the country, gaining you access to the hard-to-find items you need to get you off the job site.
about:
CED Burlington operates from Williston, Vermont, as a branch of Consolidated Electrical Distributors (CED), a national network that traces its roots to a single location opened in California in 1957. The family of companies has grown to nearly 800 locations across the United States, each empowered to make local stocking and service decisions.

The Williston location functions as a full-line electrical distributor and service provider. It stocks gear packages, load centers, disconnects, meter mains, circuit breakers and related protective devices from major manufacturers. Beyond product supply, the branch offers residential lighting design through a licensed designer, detailed takeoff services from electrical drawings, job management with custom reporting, and customer storage that holds palletized materials for just-in-time delivery. Emergency same-day delivery and after-hours availability round out the service portfolio.

Primary customers include residential and commercial electrical contractors, as well as construction firms handling service entrance equipment and switchgear assemblies. The branch positions itself as the "Residential Contractors' Supplier of Choice" in its market, while also supporting larger infrastructure projects through the national CED network.

The company emphasizes a motto of "Service. Integrity. Reliability." and credits its growth to decentralized decision-making that keeps inventory and expertise close to the job site. Differentiators cited by the branch include next-day UPS Red Label shipping on many stocked items, a licensed lighting designer on staff, and a willingness to deliver materials outside normal business hours.

name: CM Process Solutions LLC
old_description: Dump buggy tumblers have been specifically designed to revolutionize mixing processes in food, beverage and pharmaceutical manufacturing, our dump buggy tumbler offers high quality consistent and safe mixing of products such as pasta salads, RTE (ready to eat) meals and protein products like chicken, ribs, and pork loins.
about:
CM Process Solutions LLC operates from Winchester, Kentucky, where it designs and builds stainless‑steel hygienic equipment for food, beverage and pharmaceutical processors. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in public materials, and no founders are named on its website.

The product line centers on dump‑buggy tumblers — notably the TT3 model — that mix, coat, marinate, infuse and blend products such as pasta salads, ready‑to‑eat meals, chicken, ribs, pork loins and pet‑food kibble. A bi‑directional rotation system replaces paddles or blades, and a vacuum‑assist option accelerates marination of muscle meats and pulled pork. The portfolio also includes lifting and dumping systems and industrial washing equipment, all fabricated from stainless steel. A newly commissioned demonstration center allows customers to trial equipment before purchase, and the company supplies after‑sales support and spare parts.

Customers span North America’s hygiene‑conscious sectors: meat and poultry processors, prepared‑meal manufacturers, beverage plants and pet‑food producers. CM Process Solutions holds associate memberships in the Food Production Solutions Association, PMMI (The Association for Packaging & Processing Technologies), the American Association of Meat Processors and the U.S. Poultry & Egg Association, reflecting its focus on protein and packaged‑food markets.

The company positions itself as a market leader in hygienic equipment innovation, emphasizing custom‑engineered designs developed in close collaboration with each client’s engineering and production teams. The on‑site demonstration center is cited as a key differentiator, enabling real‑world process validation prior to capital commitment.

old_description: Fanuc parts and repair specialist to the machine tools industries of America and Canada. CNC Electronics Inc are leading independent Fanuc part specialists offering Fanuc parts such as GE Fanuc drives, servo and spindle units, ALPHA and BETA series amplifier module.
about:
CNC Electronics Inc was founded in 2004 in Charlottesville, Virginia, to supply and repair Fanuc parts for customers across the Americas.

The business operates as an independent Fanuc specialist, providing drives, control PCBs, power supply units, AC motors, and monitors. It also offers new U.S.‑built replacement monitors for Fanuc, Mazak, and Siemens controls. Services include parts sales, exchange (immediate swap for emergency breakdowns), repair with a typical 24‑ to 48‑hour turnaround, testing, and surplus sales. In‑house built CNC parts carry a two‑year guarantee, while all Fanuc parts come with a 12‑month warranty.

CNC Electronics serves the machine‑tool industry in the United States and Canada, supplying thousands of customers from its East Coast operation. For the western U.S., central and South America, it directs inquiries to its affiliate, CNC Electronics West Inc.

The company was started to fill a need for reliable, independent Fanuc support, emphasizing fast turnaround, warranty coverage, and the ability to keep customers’ own units during repair to avoid deposits.

The firm delivers a full range of electrical construction and service capabilities, including lightning protection, medium‑voltage distribution, design‑build projects, general electrical installation, preventive maintenance, coordination studies, switchgear work, emergency power systems, troubleshooting, and industrial automation controls. about:
CableLAN Products was founded in 1994 in Riverside, Rhode Island. The company began with a mission to provide outstanding service and value to data and telephone contractors in the Boston area. Ownership details and founders are not disclosed.

The company operates as a distributor of structured wiring products, including cable, patch cords, jacks, outlets, patch panels, racks, cabinets, test equipment, and installation accessories. It also supplies fiber optic assemblies and electrical communication cables. In 1997, a branch opened in Warwick, Rhode Island, expanding service to Rhode Island and southeastern Massachusetts. CableLAN describes itself as the largest regional distributor in New England and the largest stocking distributor of structured network products in Rhode Island. It also serves as a worldwide supplier of fiber optic and electrical communication cables to nuclear power plants.

Primary customers include data and telephone contractors in the New England region, as well as nuclear power generation facilities globally. The company’s product range supports structured cabling installations for commercial and industrial networks.

CableLAN emphasizes total value through great service, top-quality products, and competitive pricing. Long-standing relationships with manufacturing partners, many dating back to the company’s start, underpin its ability to maintain a broad inventory and respond to evolving market needs.

name: Cablecraft Motion Controls
old_description: In a world on the go, failure is not an option. That’s why, for over seventy years, Cablecraft has specialized in designing engineered solutions that keep things moving, reliably. But we don’t just manufacture quality motion control products and assemblies—our engineering and manufacturing experts collaborate with you to design answers to your most pressing motion control problems.
about:
Cablecraft Motion Controls is headquartered in St. Matthews, South Carolina. The company traces its origins to 1949 when Cablecraft was founded in Tacoma, Washington, to manufacture aircraft cable assemblies. Earlier roots go back to 1920 with J.J. Tourek Manufacturing Co. in Chicago producing precision screw-machine components, and 1954 with Superior Ball Joint Corp. in Fort Wayne, Indiana. The current entity emerged from a combination of Cable Manufacturing & Assembly and Cablecraft into a global leader in engineered motion controls.

The company designs and manufactures control cables (push and push-pull), rod ends, ball joints, mechanical linkages, and remote actuation products. It also produces mechatronic assemblies including electronic controls and electro-mechanical components. Cablecraft's engineering team develops proprietary components to reduce design time and tooling costs, and offers custom component design per proprietary requirements. Manufacturing capabilities include cable assembly, precision machining for ball joints and rod ends, and mechatronics integration. The firm operates a worldwide cable assembler network and provides engineering collaboration from concept to installation-ready delivery.

Cablecraft serves aerospace (sport aircraft), powersports (throttle and shift assemblies), construction (heavy-duty high-temperature applications), automotive (light vehicles), and industrial engine controls. Its customers include OEMs and tier suppliers seeking motion control solutions for critical applications. The company's application engineers work directly with client technical teams to adapt standard products or develop new designs.

Cablecraft was started to provide engineered motion control solutions that keep things moving reliably. The company emphasizes an application-focused philosophy, positioning itself as an engineering and problem-solving partner rather than just a product supplier. Its differentiation lies in combining proprietary component libraries with custom design capability to deliver installation-ready assemblies that reduce customer production complexity.

name: Cables Unlimited - Custom Cable Manufacturing
old_description: Cables Unlimited is a manufacturer of custom cable assemblies, custom wire harnesses, fiber cables, and custom hybrid cables to meet even the most unique challenges of the communications, automotive, military, robotic, industrial, wireless, and medical industries.
about:
Cables Unlimited operates from Yaphank, New York, where it has been producing custom cable assemblies for over 30 years. The company became a division of RF Industries (Nasdaq: RFIL) following an acquisition in June 2011, expanding its reach into the telecommunications sector. No individual founders are named in public materials.

The company designs and manufactures custom cable assemblies, wire harnesses, fiber optic cables, and hybrid cables. Its in-house capabilities span engineering design assistance, rapid prototyping, and low‑ to high‑volume production. The facility handles everything from simple copper assemblies to complex hybrid cables for cell‑tower and distributed‑antenna systems.

Cables Unlimited serves wireless and telecom carriers upgrading to 5G and LTE, military and aerospace programs requiring mil‑spec and tactical cables, robotics firms needing high‑flex‑life solutions, data‑center and networking customers using Cat 5/6 and fiber, medical device manufacturers, industrial OEMs, and enterprise clients. The company also provides installation services through certified technicians.

The business emphasizes fast turnaround and low minimum orders, backed by a Corning Gold Cable Assembly House designation that enables a 25‑year extended warranty on select fiber products. ITAR registration allows work on defense‑related projects, and the team notes a willingness to work around the clock to meet urgent deadlines.
